description: Use this when a Fantasy Premier League (FPL) manager asks for help with their team without giving it ("I play FPL, can you help with my team?"), wants to give or change it, or asks how to find their team ID: a card that finds it by name or takes their ID or link. Pass a team or manager name they said as query; with an ID or link it shows that squad. Not when a team card is already showing.

query.description: Their team's name or their name
query.title: Query

team_id.description: The manager's FPL team ID (entry ID), or any FPL link containing /entry/<id>/. Leave empty if unknown: the answer's card then finds their team with them.
team_id.title: Team Id

name: find_my_team
title: Your team
